note: Lane standin proposals (2026-10-30): better D2R stand-ins for the most-seen Median-only monsters (docs/hd-monsters.md section 16) and the boss FAILs of section 12. Owner rule: no new models; D2R's own HD units, scaled and recoloured; the owner sees the review sheets (mxl2012-runs/standin/) first. The build uses an entry only when it and this file are switched on; `hd_monsters.py build --try-proposals all` makes a trial build with all of them.

9!.why: Centaur: a pale horse body under a furred, armoured torso with a spear (101x97 px). D2R has no centaur; the Goatman stands on hoofed goat legs with fur and a pole weapon: a beast-legged armed fighter, where the Claw Viper is a snake. Pale grey like the art

!2.why: Dark Fey: a slender teal-skinned woman with green hair, melee (21x54 px). The Dark Spearwoman is D2R's slender wingless woman fighter; teal like the art. The Council Member is a robed man

&b.why: Deathwing: a bone-white skeletal flyer on bat wings (76x58 px). The Desert Wing has the bat wings and the claws; bone white like the art. The Vulture is a feathered bird

0n.why: Onyx Knight: a heavy black plate knight with gold trim, horned helm and a sword (50x114 px). The Doom Knight is D2R's horned plate knight with a sword; darkened to black with its bronze left as the trim. The Sand Raider is a thin unarmoured raider

2(.why: Fungus: a dark blue biped under a wide blue mushroom cap (53x86 px). D2R has no mushroom man; the Thorned Hulk's broad bushy head and shoulders are the nearest cap. Kept, smaller and blue like the art instead of teal

(l.why: Magma Demon: a hulking golem of dark rock with glowing lava cracks (94x104 px). The Clay Golem is D2R's hulking rock-and-earth golem, the nearest shape. Its colour cannot be changed: a darkened ember table drew it tan as ever in game (trials 1 and 2, like the Iron Golem of section 12), so it stays its own earth-tan. The Fire Golem (all flame) and the Death Mauler (a spined beast) fit the shape worse

08.why: Fell Fiend: an orange-red winged demon with tentacle legs (104x89 px), Median's AI Megademon. The Venom Lord is D2R's winged demon of that AI; shifted from red to orange. The Putrid Defiler has no wings

5$.why: Porkchop: a huge fat man in orange leather with a steel helmet and shoulder plates and a sledgehammer (160x201 px). The Overseer (Act 5) is D2R's fat hunched brute in brown-red leather, warm-tinted towards orange; it carries a whip, not a hammer. The Smith (same fat-man shape, hammer) was tried: it drew grey-blue whatever its table said (trial 2), and Hephasto is the same grey-blue model. The Siege Beast carries a tower on its back

g7.why: Pest: a small hunched armoured imp with an axe, dark brown (36x54 px). The Fallen is D2R's small hunched imp with a blade; brown instead of red. The Brute is a furred yeti

b#.why: Crystal: a woman with orange-red hair, green top and red skirt, melee (50x80 px). The Dark Spearwoman is D2R's woman fighter in red; a little brighter. The Cantor is a robed priest

#m.why: Belial (Act 5 Ice Cave boss): a hunched horned demon in black spiked armour with a rat tail and a staff (53x86 px). The Minion of Destruction stays (hunched horned clawed demon; no D2R unit has the tail); since the green state fix (#496) its colour shows, so darker brown-black like the art and a little larger

#q.before: arach1 x0.85 (shared table, drew dull red-brown)
#q.why: Enforcer with Laser: a golden box on long jointed legs (87x72 px). The Arach stays (D2R's long-legged walker); a strong gold tint of its own so it no longer falls on a shared table that kept it red-brown
